description_expanded: ABOUT BID-A-WEE BEACH BUNGALOW: Just 2 blocks from the emerald waters and PRIVATE BEACH of Panama City Beach Florida is "Bid-A-Wee Beach Bungalow." A recently custom-built home, perfectly designed and fully equipped for a vacationer's dream! Featuring 3 bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, multiple outdoor lounge areas, and a relaxing (heatable*) pool - this vacation rental was made to exceed 5-star expectations! In addition to its private beach access, modern furnishings & coastal décor, its spacious private backyard is what brings guests back to visit each year! Poolside lounging, island-style dining and nighttime bonfires are just a few of the sought-after vacation-style amenities at Bid-A-Wee Beach Bungalow. Bid-A-Wee Beach is located on the quartz shores of the Gulf of Mexico, and part of an undeveloped private beach along the Emerald Coast, which has its perks! There are specific laws that protect this area of the sandy beach so that both the beach and dunes are safe and kept in pristine condition. Since it is privately owned, the beach is less crowded than the public accesses, and you'll never find high rise condominiums or buildings of any kind, as private beach gates provide the only access to the emerald waves! Each furnished living space (both indoor and outdoor) has been well thought out to convey ultimate comfort and convenience for the entire group. Inside the open concept living, kitchen and dining space is spacious enough to pleasantly accommodate everyone. For the beloved food grazers and quick eaters in the family - the large, island-style kitchen bar is ready to serve it all up! With unique bench-style seating, the kitchen and dining area seats all 10 guests with a view of the beautifully manicured backyard pool and firepit. For those seeking a complete recharge of the soul, we recommend getting cozy on one of the poolside loungers early in the morning to watch the quiet, slow sunrise from the East. After a long sun-soaked day at the beach, there's nothing better than a warm shower and fresh food from the outdoor grill. A typical Bid-A-Wee Beach Bungalow nightcap is best spent around the backyard firepit, sharing vacation stories, and making new memories. Private French doors open to a secluded outdoor living space from the king master suite. Soft outdoor furniture underneath a private pergola awaits guests staying in this suite, along with a private ensuite featuring double vanities, a smooth soaking tub and a walk-in shower. A furnished queen bedroom, which shares a full-sized bathroom with the twin bunkroom, boat bed, and twin trundle. The full-sized laundry room is such a welcome convenience when staying several days, just throw the wet bathing suits in the dryer and continue enjoying your vacation. ABOUT THE AREA: Bid-A-Wee Beach is a unique residential community located in Panama City Beach, Florida. Known for its private beach access and family-friendly atmosphere, Bid-A-Wee Beach offers a tranquil and exclusive setting for residents and visitors alike. One of the key features of Bid-A-Wee Beach is its private beach access, which provides a more secluded and intimate beach experience compared to public beaches in the area. This exclusive access allows residents and guests to enjoy the pristine white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico in a more peaceful and uncrowded environment. The community of Bid-A-Wee Beach is characterized by charming beach cottages, vacation rental homes, and luxury beachfront properties, offering a range of accommodation options for those looking to experience beachfront living in Panama City Beach. The neighborhood has a relaxed and inviting vibe, making it an ideal destination for families, couples, and individuals seeking a serene beach retreat. In addition to its beautiful beach, Bid-A-Wee Beach is conveniently located near popular attractions, restaurants, shopping areas, and entertainment options in Panama City Beach. Visitors can explore nearby state parks, go fishing, partake in water sports, golfing, or simply relax and soak up the sun on the pristine shores of Bid-A-Wee Beach. Overall, Bid-A-Wee Beach offers a unique blend of natural beauty, exclusivity, and convenience, making it a sought-after destination for those looking to experience the best of what Panama City Beach has to offer. BEACH ACCESS: * Private Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * 8 beach towels included * Short walk to the beach * Optional pool heat available for $90 a day PARKING: * Free parking up to 3 vehicles. * Free Level 2 EV charger- charges vehicles with Tesla/NACS connectors as well as J1772 connectors. PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation. * Must Be 25 years or older. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida s Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales , you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.
